title_sq: Super zyre per shitje ne Mangalem!
description_sq:
Super zyre per shitje ne Mangalem!
Zyrat ndodhen ne kati e pare ne rezidencen Mangalem!
Shiten te mobiluara dhe te investuara gati per te filluar pune. Zyrat kane nje siperfaqe totale 200m2 dhe bashke me zyrat shiten edhe 3 poste parkimi ne te njejtin objekt.
Zyrat jane te mobiluara dhe te investuara me instalime elktrike, izolim akustik, sistem sigurie dhe monitorimi me kamera, sistem detektim zjarri, ambjent ngrenie per stafin.
Eshte e organizuar ne 3 salla te medha dhe 2 zyra me te vogla gjithashtu zyrat kane edhe 4 tualete te investuara.
Ne cmim jane te perfshire edhe 3 postet e parkimit.
title_en: Super office for sale in Mangalem!
description_en: Super office for sale in Mangalem! The offices are located on the first floor in the Mangalem residence! They are sold furnished and invested, ready to start working. The offices have a total area of ​​200m2 and together with the offices, 3 parking spaces are also sold in the same building. The offices are furnished and equipped with electrical installations, acoustic insulation, security system and camera monitoring, fire detection system, dining area for the staff. It is organized in 3 large halls and 2 smaller offices, the offices also have 4 invested toilets. The price includes 3 parking spaces.
